---
name: Name a missing treatment, with its test
about: A treatment, procedure, gene therapy or measuring tool that would have to arrive for ageing to be outrun and the tree does not have
title: "Missing treatment: "
labels: missing-treatment
---

**Which branch it belongs under** (worn-out cells; damaged DNA; the cell's settings; broken proteins and waste; energy and fuel sensing; replacing lost cells and parts; inflammation and the body's messaging; measuring ageing):

**A plain name that says what happens**, not what it is called ("A drug clears aged cells from a person", not "senolytic therapy"):

**What would count as it having happened** (written so that two readers would agree; swallowing the pill is not the thing, the result is):

**Who or what would settle that** (a peer-reviewed report with a measured number, a regulator's approval record, a trial registry; a press release or "common knowledge" is not a settler):

**The furthest stage it has reached** (idea only; shown in animals; first human; in clinical use; in wide use), **with a link to the record:**

**Your estimate of the year it reaches the clinic**, if you have one (no earlier than, most likely, no later than), with the reasoning:

How this gets folded in: a missing treatment is added as a record with its own page at a stable address, a stage, a date and a record, a first-pass estimate, and a dated line in the changelog that cites this issue, and the year is recomputed; or it is declined with the reason written back here. A treatment without a test cannot be added. See outrunningageing.com/disagree/.
